articleTitle: Tomato leaf diseases classification with convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In recent years, convolutional neural network (CNN) has developed rapidly and been widely used in plant disease detection. Tomato leaf disease is an important diseases of plant diseases. Therefore, it is necessary to improve the classification results of tomato leaf diseases. In this paper, a new CNN framework is proposed to classify tomato leaf diseases. The proposed framework includes several key deep-learning-based techniques: dilated convolution, batch normalization (BN), and the dropout after each convolutional block. Specifically, we apply dilated convolution to tomato leaf disease classification, which enlarges the receptive field without the reduction of image size. In addition, BN and the dropout are used to accelerate model convergence and reduce the redundant features generated by each convolutional block. Experiments show that the proposed model achieved the best results in both classification accuracy and the number of parameters compared with different CNN models.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Neural Network Model Deployment for Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In response to the constraints of edge computing environments, this paper conducts an in-depth optimization of the YOLOv5-based object detection model to achieve real-time high-precision object detection on edge devices. Firstly, the paper analyzes the principles of two model compression techniques: graph optimization and network quantization, to achieve structural-level optimization of the model. Then, it optimizes memory access for the model using the unified memory access mechanism of the GPU. Experimental results show that compared to the original model, the optimized YOLOv5 achieves over 5.5 times the inference acceleration on the Nvidia Jetson Xavier NX edge device, with only a slight 1.5% decrease in average precision (MAP), achieving real-time high-precision object detection. This paper provides a reference for optimizing neural network model deployment on edge devices.

articleTitle: Twin Modeling and Generative Adversarial Network Bearing Fault Diagnosis Enhancement Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In industrial production, the problem of low classification accuracy of diagnostic model due to missing bearing fault data in bearing information collection is addressed. A bearing fault diagnosis method based on twin model and generative adversarial network is proposed. Firstly, the twin model of the bearing is constructed based on the dynamics model, and the twin model is optimized and corrected according to the bearing fault mechanism and health state data to obtain a high-fidelity twin model to the high-quality twin fault data, and secondly, a feature enhancement method based on the generative adversarial network fault data is proposed, and the enhanced data is input into a convolutional neural network to be trained, so as to realize the fault diagnosis of the bearing. Experimental results show that the method can not only fill the data effectively, but also improve the rolling bearing classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Resilient Output Regulation of High-Order Multi-Agent Systems with External Disturbances and Uncertain Nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper addresses the finite-time resilient output regulation problem in high-order multi-agent systems affected by external disturbances and uncertain nonlinearities. Firstly, we propose an extended state observer aimed at estimating internal uncertainties and unknown disturbances within the system. Secondly, building upon the dynamic information provided by the observer, we devise a finite-time distributed resilient control protocol tailored for leader-follower systems. Within this protocol, compensation terms are strategically introduced to account for uncertain nonlinearities and stochastic disturbances, thus enabling consensus attainment within finite time for high-order uncertain nonlinear multi-agent systems. Rigorous analysis, rooted in graph theory and Lyapunov stability theory, is applied to rigorously assess the stability of the designed controller. Lastly, we substantiate the effectiveness of these algorithms through comprehensive simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Network Handover Control based on Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Dense network and mmWave technology are two key factors to meet the requirements of the fifth generation mobile network (5G), which have a significant effect on improving network capacity and data rate. But at the same time, the network environment will become more complex. In this case, it becomes more difficult to obtain global network information and perform real-time handover control on the network. In this paper, we design a multi-agent reinforcement learning-based handover algorithm to address this problem. We have established a fully cooperative handover (HO) control scheme, considering user rate requirements, increasing the overall effective transmission rate of the network while reducing the HO rate. Due to the interplay among user (UE) decisions in the network, we view HO control as a multi-agent cooperative task with the same goal, where all users focus on optimizing the overall network gain. The UE can get global network knowledge during the centralized training strategy, then the UE obtains a decentralized strategy, so after the training is completed, the UE no longer needs global information, and only needs to perform handover control based on the local observation of each UE. The simulation results show that the scheme improves the effective total transmission rate of the network while reducing the handover rate of the network.

articleTitle: Advantage Distillation Assisted Four-intensity Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol was initially proposed to mitigate the impact of detector side channels. However, this protocol still relies on the assumption of perfect state preparation, which is challenging to achieve in practical quantum key distribution (QKD) systems using realistic devices. In this study, we explore a novel four-state MDI-QKD protocol employing an uncharacterized source and leveraging advantage distillation technology. Our approach effectively addresses security vulnerabilities arising from both imperfections in state preparation and potential detection loopholes. Furthermore, the performance of our scheme is enhanced through the implementation of advantage distillation techniques.

articleTitle: Goal-Directed Target Discovery in Social Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Traditional information-retrieving technology in open networks mainly focused on crawling certain webpages or extracting certain attributes from webpages, however, very few studies have been done on the user scale. In the paper, we propose an innovative goal-directed target discovery approach to find the users concerned automatically in social networks. Different from the traditional methods of crawling social networks blindly and exhaustively, our method leveraged deep learning technology to guide the crawlers to cleverly find the target users with certain political stances. Finally, experiments and studies were conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Style-Infused Image Restoration with GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The restoration of old and damaged photographs has consistently been a popular issue. Old photos serve as records of bygone, cherished moments in life, carrying a myriad of emotions of the individuals who took them. However, due to limitations in photographic conditions at the time or improper preservation, these photos often exhibit mold spots, dirt, and scratches. Therefore, the restoration of old photographs holds significant importance. Conventional restoration methods primarily rely on manual intervention and typically yield mediocre results. We propose a novel two-stage network structure. In the first stage, it detects and labels scratches and dirt in old or damaged photos, forming a mask. In the second stage, a GAN network is used to generate the missing portions based on the mask. Importantly, we embed latent encoding into the network to fine-tune the image style, thereby enhancing the restoration outcome. Extensive experiments have demonstrated that our network achieves promising results in the task of restoring old and damaged photos.

articleTitle: A Range Estimation Algorithm for Correction of Spectral Line in FMCW Radar and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to enhance the ranging accuracy of FMCW radar, a high-precision ranging algorithm, referred to as the FDZ algorithm (FFT+DFT+ZFFT ranging method), has been proposed. This algorithm operates as follows: it first performs a range-Dimension Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on the input beat signal to obtain an approximate frequency range. Subsequently, to address situations where spectral refinement is susceptible to interference, it calculates the amplitude values at points around the peak frequency within $\pm \Delta f/2$, determines the spectral refinement interval, and employs the Zoom-FFT algorithm for fine-tuning. Finally, it accurately determines the peak spectral line position and target distance. MATLAB simulations have shown that, under conditions where 0dB<SNR<10dB, the FDZ algorithm outperforms the M-Rife algorithm. Furthermore, in addition to these software-based improvements, the FDZ algorithm has undergone hardware optimization. It was found that it can be efficiently implemented using a ping-pong pipeline structure. Additionally, the algorithm simplifies computational steps and facilitates the reuse of functional modules in software, resulting in lower resource consumption compared to the M-Rife algorithm.

articleTitle: Suppression of Epileptiform Activity in a Wilson-Cowan Network Model by Distributed Linear Delayed Feedback Control
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Electrical brain stimulation (EBS) has been established as a potent instrument for modulating brain activities. This paper presents a spatially distributed linear delayed feedback control (LDFC) approach for EBS, designed to suppress epileptiform activity within a Wilson-Cowan network model of the cortex. The EBS is administered distributively via a grid of stimulating electrodes positioned on the cortex, and we evaluate the efficacy of LDFC in suppressing epileptiform activity. In a large range of control parameter space (feedback gain and delay time), the overall pathological oscillations can be substantially reduced, although not entirely suppressed.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization of MFAC Based on Grey Wolf Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Model-free adaptive control (MFAC) is a data-driven control (DDC) strategy that has been widely applied in various fields. In order to overcome the challenges of parameter tuning and performance optimization, this study introduces an approach that utilizes the Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) to fine-tune and enhance the parameters of the MFAC controller. To reduce the search space of the GWO, we employed the control variable method to screen the parameters that need optimization and identified the crucial parameters that exert a substantial influence on the performance metrics of the controller. Through simulation experiments with a typical nonlinear system as the control object, we validated the efficiency and accuracy of the GWO in parameter optimization. Experimental results demonstrate a significant reduction in cumulative tracking error when using optimized parameters for control.

articleTitle: Research on Enhanced Hybrid Whale Optimization Algorithm with Inverse Learning Strategy and Lévy Flight Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In recent years, bio-inspired optimization algorithms have attained significant success in addressing complex global optimization issues. Nonetheless, a single bio-inspired search strategy may struggle to handle diverse and intricate problems. To surmount this constraint, this paper introduces an enhanced hybrid whale algorithm (MEHWOA) based on reverse learning strategy and Lévy flight mechanism improvement. This approach amalgamates the global search capabilities of the gray wolf algorithm with the local search prowess of the whale algorithm, further augmenting the convergence speed and optimization accuracy of MEHWOA by incorporating reverse learning strategy and Lévy flight mechanism. To assess the performance of MEHWOA, we conducted experiments on 23 general benchmark test functions and compared it with original gray wolf (GWO), whale (WOA), particle swarm (PSO), and sparrow search (SSA) optimization algorithms. The experimental outcomes reveal that MEHWOA exhibits faster convergence speed and superior accuracy across various test functions, including unimodal, multimodal, and composite benchmark test functions. These findings corroborate that MEHWOA possesses considerable potential for solving complex global optimization problems.

articleTitle: Cooperative Handover Performance Analysis in a Cell-Free Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: User-centric Coordinated Multipoint (CoMP) is a promising technology that can enhance handover performance in terms of network coverage and throughput. However, the increasing number of cooperative base stations (BSs) may lead to a higher handover rate, which could negatively impact user performance. This paper presents an analysis of the coverage probability and handover rate in CoMP mode and Non-CoMP mode, and provides easily manageable expressions. To balance the trade-off between handover cost and coverage capacity, we introduce average throughput as a performance indicator, and demonstrate that when the user speed is less than a certain limit, denoted as $v^{*}$, the cooperative mode outperforms the non-cooperative mode. Therefore, our proposed scheme has clear advantages in such scenarios. Monte Carlo simulation is used to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the analysis presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Second-order multi-agent consistency based on edge event triggering
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To solve the consistency problem of second-order multi-agent systems, this paper proposes a control strategy based on edge event triggering, and adds a dynamic threshold to reduce the number of events triggered. When the trigger condition is met, the agent transmits information only to the other agent on the adjacent side, avoiding sending information to all neighboring agents, which reduces the waste of system resources. The introduction of auxiliary dynamic variables allows the threshold to be dynamically adjusted to avoid the problem of events being triggered continuously. Lyapunov stability theory is used to prove that the control system based on edge event triggering is asymptotically stable without Zeno behavior, and the effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by simulation. In order to prove that the control protocol proposed in this paper can indeed reduce the number of trigger events, the paper also compares with other literatures, and concludes that using the trigger function in this paper can indeed reduce the number of trigger events, and achieve consistent time invariability, which proves the advantages of the protocol in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Development of An Onboard Intelligent Device based on Jetson NX
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of an onboard intelligent device based on Jetson Xavier NX. The device utilizes the computational and recognition capabilities of AI chips to analyze safety signs and provide feedback, assisting in inspections. The technological components and design of the onboard intelligent device are discussed, including the structural framework of embedded systems built with AI chips, as well as the components and applications of embedded systems. The DJI Maverick series models, M30 and M300, are selected and their applications and performance in the power grid industry are introduced. The unmanned aircraft and onboard intelligent device are connected through the DJI Maverick series interface for expansion and control. Edge computing is implemented using a training and computing separation model, and a development roadmap is provided. The designed onboard intelligent device is installed on DJI drones to real-time recognize video streams captured by the drones, which includes modules for data collection, computational analysis, wireless communication, storage, input/output communication, and power interfaces. Through this design, intelligent identification and real-time monitoring of public safety in the power sector can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Type-2 Fuzzy PID-Based System of Surface FES with Pulse Width Modulation for Stroke Rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To help stroke patients perform smooth and stable limb movement, and promote the recovery of lost limb function, this paper designed a closed-loop surface functional electrical stimulation (FES) rehabilitation training system based on a type-2 fuzzy PID controller. Firstly, the system detected movement angle error between the desired trajectory and the actual trajectory of wrist extension motion through two gyroscope modules real-time. Then, the MCU controller adjusted the pulse width of the applied electrical stimulation using the type-2 fuzzy PID controller according to the angle error and achieved the goal of regulating the stimulus intensity. The MCU controller also instructed the stimulating drive circuit to generate biphasic charge-balanced constant current stimulation pulses. Finally, through hydrogel electrodes, the stimulation pulse was applied to stimulation sites on the surface of forearm extension muscles, which induced the wrist to follow the desired trajectory. The system sent data, including the expected angle, actual angle, and time-varying pulse width, to a MATLAB script program for visualization through the esp8266 module. In addition, we tested and verified the performance of our system through an organized human experiment. The result shows the average Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) between the trajectory of the controlled limb and the target trajectory is 0.93 ± 0.02. Therefore, the FES rehabilitation training system based on the type-2 fuzzy PID controller in this paper could enable the paralyzed limb of hemiplegia patients to perform the same trajectories as the healthy limb.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Embedding and Multi-Head Selection Model for Nested NER
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In existing research on nested named entity recognition, span-based methods are employed to treat named entity recognition problems as span classification tasks, wherein finetuned pretrained models are utilized to facilitate more efficient recognition of nested entities. However, issues such as domain knowledge deficiency and failure to realize multi-classification are still unsolved. To address these issues, this paper innovatively put forward a Multi-Head Model Based on Knowledge Embedding (MKE), which: (1) introduces domain-specific background knowledge in the form of entity matrices, allowing the background knowledge to be embedded without any loss, and (2) transforms named entity recognition into a multi-head selection process, followed by scoring the candidate spans using the attention score model. This method realizes entity multi-classification, while also ensuring accurate identification of nested entity boundaries. The experimental results show that the background knowledge embedding realized by the entity matrix method is able to not only elevate the recognition accuracy, but also achieve the state-of-theart performance on seven nested and flat named entity recognition datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Control Quality Evaluation System of Static Shift for a Hydraulic Mechanical Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In this paper, the dynamics and control process of static shift of vehicle hydraulic mechanical transmission device are analyzed, and the generation mechanism, influencing factors and characterization parameters of static shift shock are identified. This work proposes a static shift quality evaluation system with three levels. The static shift quality evaluation system includes 8 evaluation indexes and five evaluation essentials. The evaluation system defines the scientific definition and calculation method of the evaluation index, and the calculation method of the evaluation system score. It provides a theoretical support for the evaluation of static shift control results and optimization of control strategy of vehicles.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Consensus of Single-Integrator Multi-Agent Systems in the Presence of Asynchronous Self-Sensing Function Failures
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Noticing that the existing fault-tolerance consensus protocol suitable for synchronous self-sensing function failures (SSSFFs) cannot be directly applied to consensus of single-integrator multiple agent systems (SIMASs), a part of agents of which are subjected to asynchronous SSFFs (ASSFFs), this paper tries to develop a new consensus protocol that has fault tolerance against ASSFFs. First, the network communication topology connectivity restoration (NCTCR) strategy suitable for SSSFFs is used for solving NCTCR under ASSFFs by regarding ASSFFs as multiple SSSFFs. Second, a fault-tolerance consensus protocol suitable for ASSFFs is designed based on the strategy that when the minimum-hop normal neighbor set (MHNNS) of an agent subjected to SSFF changes, its current state is computed by its outdated data. Third, consensus convergence is analyzed, deriving the convergence conditions on the time-varying gain (TVG). It is theoretically proved that consensus is achieved for SIMASs using the NCTCR strategy and the fault-tolerance consensus protocol with the appropriate TVG. Forth, numerical simulation experiments illustrate the validity of the proposed fault-tolerance consensus protocol.

articleTitle: Intelligent monitoring module designed for industrial IoT scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: ZigBee wireless sensor network-based industrial monitoring system is demonstrated. The system employs TCP/IP and MQTT protocols to communicate with the web server. It adopts the iTop-4412 development platform as the hub linking the sensor control layer and the application service layer. The improved lightweight YOLOv5 algorithm detects whether workers are wearing helmets and reflective clothing to monitor industrial site safety. Sensors collect temperature and humidity in real-time, and issue commands to the equipment as necessary. Experiments have shown that the system has stable performance and can effectively regulate industrial equipment. It can also monitor temperature and humidity, and determine whether workers wear helmets and reflective clothing.

articleTitle: Multi-cycle Deep Recurrent Learning for Power Consumption Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Electricity load forecasting plays an important role in the overall layout of power grid energy regulation. The accuracy, interpretability, and expansibility of the power load forecasting system will profoundly affect the final result of power forecasting and the final operation decision of the corresponding regional power grid companies. The existing load forecasting methods (e.g., LightGBM) mainly focus on the forecasting task of univariate output, while the autoregressive models (e.g., LSTM) are often affected by the comprehensive quality of the datasets, so it is difficult to complete the task of cross-time period prediction. To address constraint issues and improve accuracy in enterprise forecasting, we apply Shapelet-Kmeans classification, a GRU-based learning model for cross-industry challenges, and multi-task learning for short and medium-long load forecasting. Our focus lies in 2021-2023 electricity load data analysis and predictions for 2,000 regional companies.

articleTitle: Research on Improving The Deep Learning Model of Differential Privacy Using Normalization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the accumulation and processing of large amounts of personal data, privacy protection has become an important issue in the field of deep learning today. The current mainstream privacy protection method is the DPSGD mechanism that combines differential privacy and stochastic gradient descent. It protects data privacy by adding a random noise to the gradient during the training process, but it also brings certain flaws. The first is the complexity of adding noise and the choice of noise parameters. Choosing appropriate noise parameters is critical to maintaining model utility while protecting privacy, but this often requires extensive experimentation and tuning. On the other hand, the performance of DPSGD may be affected by the dependence and distribution of data. If the data is not independently and identically distributed, or the data distribution changes significantly at different points in time, this may affect the effect of differential privacy protection. In response to the problem of model performance degradation caused by adding noise, this paper studies the impact of the normalization layer on the performance of DPSGD and integrates batch normalization and DPSGD without causing additional privacy loss.

articleTitle: Outsourced Attribute-Based Encryption Scheme Based on Semantic Technology in Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: As a new computing paradigm, fog computing extends the ability of cloud computing to the edge of the network and is widely used in the Internet of Things scenario. However, with the rapid development of fog computing, the problem of data security is becoming more and more obvious. It is very important to establish an efficient access control mechanism in fog computing. CP-ABE is an effective encryption mechanism, which is very suitable for fine-grained access control in distributed scenarios. However, in the process of applying CPABE to fog computing, there are problems such as low computational efficiency and complex attribute management. According to the characteristics of fog computing scenarios, this paper makes theoretical research and algorithm improvement on the access control mechanism based on CP-ABE, and proposes an outsourced attribute-based encryption scheme supporting attribute semantic mapping. The scheme is established in the environment of multiple attribute authorization agencies, and realizes outsourcing encryption and outsourcing decryption, which greatly improves the computational efficiency of the terminal. In addition, semantic technology is used to manage the attributes in the system, and the user 's attribute key is semantically enhanced to realize the semantic mapping of attributes. Security and performance analysis show that the scheme is secure under the DBDH assumption and has high computational performance.

articleTitle: Legendre pseudo-spectral method for solving the optimal starting pendulum of a rotating inverted pendulum
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The inverted pendulum is an underdriven system with multivariable, nonlinear and strong coupling. For the time-optimal swing problem of inverted pendulum, the mathematical model of inverted pendulum is established by generalized projection method. The optimal control problem (OCP) is transformed into a nonlinear programming problem (NLP) for solving by the pseudo-spectral method. And the steps of Legendre’s pseudo-spectral method for transforming into a Bolza-type optimal control problem are summarized. The solution of this optimal control problem is realized by the MATLAB toolbox OptimTraj. The experimental results show that the pseudo-spectral method has better computational efficiency and speed, and has good results in solving complex optimal control problems.

articleTitle: Low-Jitter Retimer Circuits for High-Performance Computer Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The 56Gbaud Retimer chip is the core chip for high-speed optical communication data transmission of high performance computers, and its jitter performance restricts the overall performance of optical module high performance computers. Aiming at the difficult problem of low jitter performance of traditional high-speed Retimer chips, a low jitter Retiemr circuit framework based on CDR+ PLL is proposed, using a jitter-cancelling filter circuit to improve the output data jitter performance and solving the problem of high output data jitter caused by direct sampling and forwarding of traditional Retimer. The circuit is designed using a 28nm process with an area of 0.18mm2. Simulation results show that the output data jitter of the Retimer is 741 fs when fed with 112 Gbps of high-speed PAM4 data, a 31.4% reduction compared to conventional Retimer structures.

articleTitle: Secure Access for Massive Devices in the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the context of the widespread adoption of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technology, the number of IoT devices is rapidly increasing, leading to a significant security concern in the form of device impersonation attacks. LoRa devices, as common wireless IoT terminal devices, play a critical role in ensuring the security of the IoT ecosystem through their identity recognition mechanisms. This paper presents a method for secure access of massive IoT devices based on LoRa wireless fingerprints. The proposed method extracts fingerprint features from three types of LoRa devices, which serve as unique wireless identifiers, enabling rapid identification of a large number of LoRa-based IoT devices. The process begins with preprocessing and feature extraction of the collected signals, resulting in three distinctive feature sets that form the wireless fingerprints of the devices. These fingerprints are then used to train a classification model using the K-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm. The trained model is subsequently employed to predict the device identity by analyzing the fingerprints of the devices to be identified. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system achieves a recognition accuracy of 95.3% under a signal-to-noise ratio of 55dB, while requiring a minimal training time of only 0.3169 seconds.

articleTitle: Automatic deflection detection of bridge and gantry cranes based on PLC control technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: When calculating the deflection load value of bridge and gantry cranes, there is a problem of low accuracy in the calculation and detection of the deflection load value of bridge and gantry cranes, which has always been a bottleneck restricting the development of the bridge and gantry crane industry. In order to solve this problem, researchers successfully constructed an automated detection model for the deflection of bridge and gantry cranes using PLC control technology. By introducing PLC control technology, the problem of low accuracy in calculating and detecting the deflection load value of gantry cranes has been successfully solved. This not only has positive significance for the development of the industry, but also provides new ideas and directions for other related industries.

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method based on Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the same scene, infrared images and visible light images contain significantly different information, and image fusion techniques can combine them into a single image to enhance image quality. Over the past few years, the field of image fusion has experienced a significant transformation with the advent of deep learning techniques. However, existing fusion strategies for combining infrared and visible light images based on deep learning suffer from the lack of well-designed loss functions, leading to suboptimal fusion results. Addressing the aforementioned issue, a fusion method for infrared and visible light images based on residual network is presented in this study. This method leverages the deep characteristics of residual networks to extract features and combine shallow and deep features to quantify the information content within the original images, guiding the training of the fusion network to achieve the final fused image. The experimental outcomes on TNO and RoadScene datasets validate the efficacy of the proposed method in attaining fusion results of superior quality.

articleTitle: Research of online learning status monitoring based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In contrast to traditional classroom settings, online teaching leverages network technology to facilitate instruction. A pressing challenge in this domain is the effective monitoring of students’ engagement levels to optimize learning outcomes. Addressing this, the present study introduces a deep learning-based online classroom system equipped with a learning status monitoring feature. This system employs image processing techniques and software development to capture and analyze students’ postures during online sessions, thereby providing educators and guardians with comprehensive insights into students’ engagement levels.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Load Prediction Method Based on Nonlinear Auto-Regressive Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Accurately predicting the charging load of electric vehicles is fundamental for studying the impact of large-scale electric vehicle integration on the power grid and is an important measure for ensuring the safe and economical operation of charging stations. To improve the accuracy of ultra-short-term charging load forecasting at electric vehicle charging stations, a prediction method based on the NAR (Nonlinear Autoregressive) neural network is proposed. The model selects Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) as the network training method and employs a recursive prediction approach to forecast medium- to long-term clock deviation, along with a designed data preprocessing scheme based on clock deviation variation. The NAR model is utilized to conduct short-term forecasting of the charging load of electric vehicles and is experimentally compared with the Backpropagation (BP) neural network method. The results demonstrate that the NAR network model exhibits good predictive performance for charging load forecasting, outperforming the BP neural network model, with prediction error values lower than those of the BP neural network. Therefore, the NAR neural network proves effective in addressing nonlinear problems with dynamic characteristics and temporal relationships, presenting advantages of high accuracy and low error in resolving electric vehicle charging station load prediction issues.

articleTitle: Construction of Parking Space Recommendation Model Based on Big Data and Multi attribute Decision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: this paper studies the construction of parking recommendation model based on Hadoop under big data. In order to solve the problem of real-time monitoring and recommendation of traditional parking spaces, this paper proposes to use Hadoop technology to analyze and process unstructured data. The system uses large-scale parallel database Greenplum technology for data storage and processing, realizes the rapid query of data, and constructs the technical model of parking recommendation analysis system. The system uses multi-attribute optimal decision-making algorithm to achieve real-time recommendation of massive parking spaces.

articleTitle: An improved target detection algorithm applied to domestic edge computing module
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: An improved single-stage object detection algorithm SSD method is proposed. The feature extraction layer is modified to MobileNetV2, and the model is compressed to reduce the number of parameters and calculation. It is applied to the domestic embedded platform Bitmain SE5, with excellent performance. Compared with the classical yolov7-tiny algorithm, the computational efficiency is improved by 42%.

articleTitle: Application of GAP Technique in Ship Observation System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Data exchange is widely used in ship observation system. The introduction of GAP technique into ship observations using iridium communication not only provides sound solution to problems arising in real-time interaction between business operation networking system and external networking system, but also achieve the purpose of interactive trasmission, secured sharing and efficient utilization of hydrometeorological data. This article provides a detailed introduction to the definition, function, and composition of GAP. A secure real-time interaction system between internal and external networks is introduced in detail, including the network structure, the functional implementation, and the security analysis of the ship measurement and reporting system. This system not only provides security based on physical isolation, but also achieves high-speed data exchange.

articleTitle: Design of a Micro Corrosion Monitoring System Based on Dynamic Polarization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Aiming at the existing electrochemical corrosion workstation with large size and high power, which cannot be installed on the pipe wall to monitor the defects of corrosion values in real time, this paper designs a corrosion monitoring system based on the dynamic polarization of small and low-power consumption. The system uses STM32 as the development platform, and the communication module uses USB to TTL DTU IoT platform, which can monitor the data changes in real time. The measurement circuit uses a constant potential detection circuit, which applies a constant rate of potential difference between the working and reference electrode circuits to form a fixed frequency dynamic potential sweep. The system can monitor the corrosion system for a long time, with good real-time data, high signal strength, low cost, easy to put, and low power consumption, which effectively ensures the system’s stable operation and saves human and material resources.

articleTitle: Harnessing the Power of GPT-3 and LSTM for Natural Language Processing in Agricultural Product News: Focus on Soybeans
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In recent years, there have been remarkable advancements in deep learning and natural language processing (NLP) techniques, leading to significant improvements in extracting valuable insights from textual data. However, applying these techniques effectively to domain-specific content, such as agricultural news, presents unique challenges. In this study, we investigate the utilization of GPT-3 (Generative Pre-trained Transformer 3)’s impressive language understanding capabilities in conjunction with LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) networks, which are well-known for their ability to capture sequential dependencies. Our objective is to enhance the processing and analysis of soybean-related news headlines. Through our experimental analysis, we demonstrate that the fusion of GPT-3 and LSTM models results in a substantial improvement in the accuracy and effectiveness of sentiment analysis specifically in the context of agricultural product news. This research contributes to the expansion of knowledge and paves the way for advancements in the field of emotional analysis within the context of soybean-related news.

articleTitle: Computer-aided method for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation detection based on ECG signals
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF) is a common cardiac arrhythmia characterized by irregular contractions of the atria. In this paper, we propose a new classification method based on surface 12-lead electrocardiography (ECG) signals by using statistical analysis and deep learning models for PAF detection. First, we extract signals with a frequency range of 1-40Hz from preprocessed ECG and divide them into three frequency bands. Secondly, we calculate the phase locking value (PLV) between the twelve channels of the ECG signals and generate a correlation matrix. After bilinear interpolation and binarization, the PLV correlation matrix is obtained as a feature and plotted as a feature map. Finally, we input feature maps of different frequency bands into the Rstnet18 convolutional neural network, and achieving a promising performance.

articleTitle: Application of double closed-loop multi-coupling serial control data decoupling techniques to aircraft cockpit loop control systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The temperature, pressure, angle and rotation control products involved in in-flight cockpit loop control mostly use double closed-loop multi-coupling cascade control technology, involving two or more controlled indicators, and the control orientation has the effect of cascade control, and the coupling phenomenon is serious, resulting in poor control effect or only one controlled object can be controlled well. The aim of this project is to discover the laws governing the generation of dual closed-loop multi-coupled cascade control data, learn from the experimental data using BP neural networks, fit the formulas and optimise the processing for eventual application in the control engineering of aircraft cockpit loop control systems.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-channel Voice Data Acquisition and Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Employing synchronized voice capture devices improves dispersed voice data analysis while avoiding interference. This study uses TLV320ADC3140 audio chip and STM32F767 microcontroller for an 8-channel microphone source solution. I2S and I2C buses enable microcontroller control and data acquisition. Speex-based audio compression and real-time clock-based storage accelerate file retrieval. Multi-channel voice data separation testing confirms complete capture and playback. Future work aims to refine compression techniques.

articleTitle: Applying Binary Code Similarity Detection on Acceleration Processor
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Binary code similarity detection, as an integral part of network security, has remained a hot spot in the research fields of intellectual property protection, vulnerability detection, patch analysis, and malicious software detection. It carries significant usability value. With the rapid development of deep learning and neural network technologies, new algorithms and thoughts have been introduced into the research of binary code similarity detection, achieving breakthrough progress. MT-3000, a heterogeneous multi-zone acceleration processor, which is entirely designed and implemented by National University of Defense Technology, possesses powerful computing performance. In this paper, based on the latest deep learning theory and using the domestically produced and controllable high-performance MT-3000 acceleration processor for relevant tests and researches on the binary code similarity detection, proposes relevant conclusions and suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on Monitoring Authority Management of Intelligent Ship Electromechanical System Based on Soundprints
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Applying voiceprint technology to the marine field, its robustness is only important, this paper establishes a voiceprint recognition model based on TDNN-Transformer, which improves its robustness compared with the traditional voiceprint recognition model, and adapts more to the real cabin environment. The highest correct result of 98.43 was achieved on the zhvoice speech dataset, and the stable correct rate reached about 95%. A virtual test platform for voice interaction was written, which was interconnected with the turbine simulator via UDP protocol to realize the virtual testing of control commands, and the experimental results show that voiceprint recognition has enough in robustness to be applied to the field of ship turbines in the virtual test environment.

articleTitle: Communication power supply design based on PFC and LLC
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to meet the high power and high stability requirements of communication base stations for power supply, this paper designs a dedicated 500W switch power supply for communication base stations. The front stage adopts power factor correction circuit, and the back stage adopts LLC resonant conversion circuit, and its simulation analysis is conducted.

articleTitle: Research on Laboratory Security Situational Awareness System Based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the deep causes of laboratory safety accidents and the new needs of essential safety management through the cases of laboratory safety accidents in recent years. Based on Niagara ecology and microservice architecture, the design scheme of laboratory security situation awareness system is proposed. The sensing layer deploys a variety of sensors such as temperature sensing, light sensing and inductance in the laboratory, and integrates smart sockets, smart door locks and other devices to carry out systematic and comprehensive online monitoring of the laboratory working environment. Wireless communication technologies such as NB-IOT and Wi-Fi are used for data transmission. The edge layer uses Honeywell’s JACE8000 as the data aggregation access point. After pre-processing the original data, the multi-modal sensing data of the laboratory is gathered into Huawei OceanConnect iot platform for information management and data mining, so as to realize the perception, monitoring and prediction of the laboratory security situation. Thus forming a complete laboratory security situation monitoring system.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Federated Learning Joint Communication and Computation Framework Over Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Energy efficiency continues to be a challenge in federated learning. In this paper, we investigate the energy efficiency of computational and transmission resource allocation for federated learning over wireless networks. In order to minimize the total energy consumption, a given completion time and packet error rate constraint are considered. A closed-form solution is derived for the CPU frequency, bandwidth allocation, and transmission power using the Lagrange Multiplier Method. The effects of both local and global iterations on training accuracy and energy consumption are discussed. Compared with other baselines, the proposed joint communication and computation framework greatly improves the energy efficiency of federated learning, reducing energy consumption by 66.8% and 48.3%, respectively.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Algorithm Based Unmanned Surface Vehicles Task Allocation Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In this paper, in order to solve the problem of USV mutual cooperation task allocation, we improve the algorithm on the basis of the traditional ant colony algorithm to solve the TSP problem, and establish a model to allocate tasks to USV under the previously set heterogeneous conditions, which reflects the consumption optimization in the final result. Secondly, this paper is different from the traditional ACO algorithm in that it uses ants with multiple division of labor mechanism to correspond to different types of USV, for a group of ant colonies there are restrictions on the number and type of ants, through which the ant colonies go to complete the task objectives and come up with the optimal results; for the target point there is still the phenomenon of heterogeneity, and the ants required for each objective are not equal in both the number and type of ants, so that the task allocation can be realized on the basis of the mutual selection of the ant colonies and the target point. Finally, this paper distinguishes the pheromone, the pheromone of traditional ACO algorithm refers to a kind of data left behind by ants under the paths they traveled, which has an impact on the probability selection, while in this paper, the ant colony and the target point select each other, and need to set different pheromones, so that the two select each other under different probabilities. Through simulation experiments, after 200 iterations to make the objective function converge, the allocation and order between 8 USV and 8 mission target points are determined.

articleTitle: Application of an Improved Ant Colony Algorithm in Vehicle Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Ant colony algorithm is prone to falling into local optima during the search process. In order to enhance the exploration ability of the algorithm, a hybrid ant colony algorithm with hierarchical optimization is proposed by combining the ant colony algorithm and neighborhood search strategy. The algorithm is divided into two stages: initial solution and precision optimization. In the initial solution stage, ant colony algorithm is mainly used to find paths, and neighborhood search strategy is combined to perturb and increase the diversity of solutions. After the ant colony algorithm obtains the initial solution, the algorithm enters the accuracy optimization stage and performs deep neighborhood transformation on the initial optimal value to improve the solution accuracy. The performance of the algorithm was verified using a vehicle routing problem test set, and the results showed that the improved ant colony algorithm in this paper can achieve good optimization results in different scale vehicle routing problem examples.

articleTitle: A printed formula recognition method based on the "Encoder-Decoder" deep learning model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the popularization of computers and the rapid development of internet technology, electronic books and literature have become important information carriers. Therefore, digitization and informatization of scientific and technological books and literature containing a large number of mathematical formulas has become an important task. Although OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology has high efficiency and accuracy in text recognition processing, it provides a convenient method for digitization and informatization of scientific and technological books, literature, etc. However, due to the complex two-dimensional structure of mathematical formulas and the diverse logical relationships and varying sizes between characters, OCR technology is not ideal for recognizing mathematical formulas. This paper proposes a deep learning model of "encoder-decoder" to solve the recognition problem of printed mathematical formulas. Utilize the powerful expression and sequence modeling capabilities of Vision Transformer and Transformer architecture to achieve accurate recognition of printed mathematical formulas. Through experimental verification, the model has achieved the expected recognition results on the publicly available printed mathematical formula datasets, with high recognition accuracy, fast running speed, and automatic generation of editable formats. This indicates that the model has potential in this field and provides new directions and choices for further improvement and application.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Method Based on BiGRU and CBAM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the increase of social informatization, network security incidents occur frequently, and the security problem is paid more and more attention. Network intrusion detection is one of the important components of network security. Aiming at the current problems of data imbalance and low detection accuracy of anomalous traffic, this paper proposes an intrusion detection method based on BiGRU and CBAM. First, we use ADASYN adaptive oversampling and class balancing to oversample a few classes of anomalous data to solve the data imbalance problem. After that, we learn the temporal features of the data through a bidirectional long and short-term memory network, we introduce spatial attention and temporal attention CBAM, and the fused features are assigned different weights, and finally output the detection results. Experimental tests are conducted on the NSL-KDD dataset, and the results show that the model in this paper has higher accuracy and lower false detection rate compared with the current machine learning and deep learning models.

Author Keywords: bi-directional long and short-term memory networks

articleTitle: A Security Verification System Based on Bilinear Maps in the Multi-cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: As cloud computing continues to grow, an increasing amount of sensitive data is migrated to the cloud for storage and processing. However, sensitive data is usually stored in a single cloud environment, which poses several risks such as data leakage and a single point of failure. To address the above issues, a security verification system based on bilinear maps in the multi-cloud environment (i.e. SVS-BM) is proposed. In the paper, bilinear mapping technology is used to ensure the integrity and authenticity of user data during transmission and processing in the multi-cloud. Moreover, trusted middleware connects the terminal to multiple cloud service providers, which ensures efficient management and security verification of user data by segmenting and merging user data. Experimental results and performance analysis show that the system can effectively guarantee user data integrity and security in the multi-cloud environment.

articleTitle: VECCTO: An Collaborative Task Offloading Framework for UAV-Assisted Vehicular Edge Clusters
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) provide Vehicle Edge Clusters (VECs) with robust signal coverage and data offloading capabilities, but they have limitations when dealing with heterogeneous cluster environments and dynamic task resource requests. This paper presents VECCTO, a collaborative task offloading framework designed specifically for UAV-assisted VEC that seeks to address the scalability and dynamics challenges in VEC task offloading. VECCTO incorporates the Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic (A3C) mechanism, which includes a centralized global Critic in the base station and a distributed local Actor in the UAV. It obtains and trains the global state value function of the entire VEC via the target network and independently updates the task offloading policy parameters of each sub-VEC based on the policy gradient, thus autonomously learning the task offloading policy. We evaluate the efficacy of VECCTO using the modified Google Cluster Usage Tracing (GCT) dataset. The results demonstrate that VECCTO efficiently manages task offloading in UAV-assisted VECs, achieving low latency while assuring load balancing among sub-VECs, which makes it a promising solution for next-generation IoV ecosystems.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing cross-domain fault diagnosis based on transfer learning domain generalization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In rolling bearing fault diagnosis field, A domain generalization transfer learning method is proposed to solve the problem of dealing with noise components in vibration data collected from various working conditions, which can impact diagnostic results. The proposed method generalize the fault diagnosis knowledge learned from multiple source domains to an invisible target domain with different working conditions than the source domain. Firstly, the labeled vibration signal and unlabeled different motor load vibration signal are made through a fixed length data segmentation method. Secondly, pre-train convolutional neural network model with source domain time spectrum data set and its labels. Furthermore, to solve the problem of inconsistent feature distribution under different working conditions of the data, we using Causality Inspired Representation Learning (CIRL) algorithm. The data sets of CWRU publicly rolling bearing fault collected under different motor load are experimental verified. The results show that the proposed method achieves a recognition accuracy of over 99.8%. Moreover, in complex operating conditions with a strong noisy environment, the accuracy of this method shows a obvious superiority compared to other diagnostic methods.

articleTitle: A construction and optimization method of a highly available intelligent domain name system
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The Domain Name System (DNS) is the infrastructure and crucial resource of the Internet. Self-built DNS systems commonly face management issues such as availability and security. Firstly, we thoroughly analyze the current status and problems of DNS construction, and propose a domain name system construction framework that has high reliability and flexibility. Then, in practical applications, an optimized DNS resolution method is proposed for a multi-operator network environment. Finally, through empirical verification, it has been demonstrated that this method enables users to obtain the optimal CDN service node, thereby improving network service quality.

articleTitle: With Fused Point Cloud Height and Intensity Information improved the Loop Closure Detection for LeGO-LOAM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is primarily divided into two components: the front-end odometry and the back-end optimization. During the measurement process, errors in feature extraction and noise effects lead to an accumulation of discrepancies between the estimated position by the front-end odometry and the actual position over time. Therefore, loop closure detection is introduced for back-end optimization. It corrects accumulated errors by identifying previously visited landmarks or positions in the scene. This paper builds upon the LeGO-LOAM-SC SLAM algorithm, which combines scan context and lightweight ground optimization LiDAR Odometry and Mapping (LeGO-LOAM). We integrate point cloud intensity information into the global descriptor to mitigate feature loss and consequent misalignment caused by the use of a single descriptor. Loop closure detection is performed using the fused global descriptor. When a loop frame is detected, the relative pose between the current frame and the history is added as a constraint to GTSAM for graphical optimization and point cloud map construction. Experiments conducted on the publicly available KITTI dataset’s sequence 05 demonstrate that the proposed enhanced algorithm outperforms existing methods in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Reinforcement Learning in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In recent years, with the iterative update of artificial intelligence technology, reinforcement learning has also been rapidly developed and gradually applied in many fields. At present, there are relatively few literatures describing the development trend of reinforcement learning in the field of network security. Therefore, we use knowledge graph to visually analyze 611 related articles downloaded from the Web of Science (WoS), including literature volume analysis, co-citation analysis and keyword co-occurrence analysis. Finally, the development prospects, important achievements and research hotspots of reinforcement learning in the field of network security are analyzed.

articleTitle: Knowledge extraction and entity linking model based on attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the field of natural language processing, entity extraction, relation extraction, and entity linking are important tools for processing unstructured data. However, the mainstream methods are to carry out each task alone, ignoring the connection between these tasks. In the paper, we propose the pipeline model (PALC-R, POStag-Attention-LSTM-CRF Relation Extraction) of knowledge extraction to complete the extraction of entities and relations. We also propose a joint learning model of entity extraction and entity linking named PALC-DCA (PALC-Dynamic Context Augmentation), to improve the accuracy by sharing local scores obtained in the entity linking module and learning the description information in the third-party knowledge base. The experiments show that entity extraction can achieve the accuracy of 90.84% on CONLL03 dataset, the accuracy of relation extraction is 81.77%, and the accuracy of entity linking on the AIDA CONLL dataset is 94.18%.

articleTitle: KBEE: Linux Kernel Vulnerability Exploitability Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The development of kernel fuzzing tools has greatly accelerated the discovery of Linux kernel errors. Fuzzing tools can automatically generate bug reports. The bug reports can guide kernel analysts in assessing the exploitability of bugs and thus prioritizing bug fixes. However, it is easy to underestimate the exploitability of bugs just by the currently exhibited bug behavior. Through different paths or being in different kernel states, a bug may exhibit a variety of bug behaviors that hide different exploitability. We propose a state-driven kernel fuzzing technique to explore the different error behaviors that kernel defects may bring. Unlike traditional coverage-oriented fuzzing, we aim at exploring different states of defective code segments such that bugs exhibit different behaviors, which in turn facilitate the evaluation of exploitability. To evaluate the effectiveness of the techniques we proposed, a KBEE tool is implemented and applied to 50 kernel bugs. Experiments show that KBEE finds a larger number of kernel bugs and is more efficient compared to the state-of-the-art tool GREBE.

articleTitle: Research on local instrument data collection method in ship engine room based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To reduce shipbuilding costs or add automation to older ships with minimal hull modification, this paper introduces a meter recognition method based on image processing. Initially, the captured image undergoes a series of preprocessing steps, including cropping, grayscale conversion, and binarization. Subsequently, Hough circle detection determines gauge blockage, followed by angle determination for an exposed gauge pointer using the rotating virtual straight line technique. Finally, the angle is translated into an indication based on the functional relationship between the pointer angle and the meter reading. This paper’s algorithm is validated in a Python development environment using the OpenCV vision library, and the results demonstrate that the algorithm is highly accurate and suitable for real ship operations.

articleTitle: Low Power Intelligent Haptic System Based on Elastic Wave Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Intelligence is a trend in the development of modern society. It gives the machines the ability to control their own behavior in a specific way, in which touch becomes one of the most important sensations. A low-power intelligent haptic system was developed based on elastic wave technology using self-developed sensors and low-power chips in this paper. This intelligent haptic system can be used to perceive human touch in consumer electronics products, including IOTs, and can also be used in automotive electronics to accurately locate the touch or collision position of the car, thereby making intelligent measures to protect human safety. This system has been applied to cars and consumer electronics with mass products. With comparation experiments and mass-production certification, it has been proven that elastic wave technology is more competitive than other haptic technologies.

articleTitle: Multi-attention Based Face Forgery Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Problems such as low accuracy and weak generalisation performance are common in existing deep face forgery detection algorithms. In order to effectively detect the features of forged faces, a deep neural network detection method based on multi-attention mechanism is proposed. Firstly, ResNet50 convolutional neural network is used to extract preliminary forged features from the input face image; secondly, channel attention in hybrid attention is used to capture the abnormal features of the forged face, and combined with spatial attention to focus on the location of the abnormal features, fully learn the semantic information of the abnormal part of the forged face in the shallow layer, and then get the shallow feature maps by sequentially connecting the two; and then, the shallow feature maps are inputted into the Then the shallow feature map is input into the dual-layer attention to get the deep feature map; finally, the deep features are input into the classification module for accurate classification. The detection accuracy of the proposed method under two different compression rates of FaceForensics+ + dataset reaches 97.74% and 91.46% respectively, while the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve reaches 98.97% and 95.87% respectively, which is better than methods such as XceptionNet and Efficientnet. The experimental results show that the proposed method has good accuracy and strong generalisation performance.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Video Stream Authentication Based on SM2 in H.264
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Due to the vulnerability of H.264/AVC video streams to tampering or substitution attacks during network transmission, the integrity and authenticity of transmitted video stream data cannot be guaranteed. To address this issue, this paper proposes a real-time video stream authentication method based on the SM2 algorithm. Utilizing SM2's digital signature technology on an embedded MCU, the method employs GOP (Group of Pictures) as the unit for digital signatures. Through the H.264 protocol's custom type of NALU, the digital signature results are cleverly overlaid onto the original transmission stream. This approach ensures that the overlaid signature results maintain compliance with the H.264 standard, causing no disruption to the original video stream data while preserving compatibility and non-intrusiveness. The method provides an efficient, secure, and viable solution for video stream authentication, with potential widespread applications in the fields of security monitoring and video transmission.

articleTitle: Design of Message and File Delivery System Based on C plus plus and QtToolkit
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Messaging and document delivery systems are tools that can reduce the burden of record-keeping on staff, across disciplines and job content. Even though they are widely used, messaging and document delivery systems need to be constantly developed and improved. This is due to the differences in the needs of different industries and organizations, and the growing needs of emerging industries and fields. In addition, constant advances in technology and user feedback drive developers to continually improve existing software to help users in ways that are more responsive to their work and more efficient. With messaging and file transfer systems, users can improve data collection efficiency, reduce the occurrence of errors, and ensure data accuracy and consistency. The multi-threaded design allows the software to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, increasing the speed of data collection and report generation. Meanwhile, through socket network programming, the software can exchange data and communicate with other systems or devices to realize real-time data updating and sharing. In summary, the message and file delivery system developed in this paper provides an effective way of implementation, and it is hoped that this approach can provide some inspiration for others as a viable form.

articleTitle: Research on network security situation awareness prediction model based on deep learning methods
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The model of network security situational awareness allows for accurate prediction of forthcoming network security incidents by analyzing historical network security data, thereby helping to detect and respond to potential network security threats in advance and protect network security. In this paper, a novel approach for network security situational awareness is introduced, which can predict future network security events by analyzing historical network traffic data. The model utilizes the LSTM neural network structure, which can capture long-term dependencies in time series data to better predict the occurrence of cybersecurity incidents. In this model, the network traffic data is firstly preprocessed, including data standardization and so on. Then, feed the preprocessed data into the LSTM model for training. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves significantly more predictive performance on multiple real test sets. Compared with traditional methods, this model can better realize network security situation awareness. Future research can further refine the design and improvement of the model to adapt to the changing cybersecurity environment, and explore the combination of more features and deep learning models to improve the prediction and response capabilities of cybersecurity.

articleTitle: An Improved Artificial Potential Field Method for Aircraft Path Planning Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to address complex Three-dimensional (3D) obstacle environments, a novel aircraft trajectory planning method is proposed, which combines deep reinforcement learning with improved artificial potential fields. In this method, an improved artificial potential field (APF) algorithm is used as the basic method. According to the relative states of the aircraft and obstacles and the types of obstacles, the appropriate normative modeling method of the training environment of deep reinforcement learning is studied. The repulsion coefficient is obtained through the training of the depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm to modify the flight path of the aircraft. Simulation results show that the proposed method achieves better path planning results than traditional path planning method and improved artificial potential field method.

articleTitle: A load balancing scheme of concurrent Internet of Things terminal equipment based on p-probability delay
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: We find ourselves amidst a phase of rapid advancement in the field of the Internet of Things (IoT). The remarkable surge in IoT devices has exerted substantial pressure on communication edge devices, particularly communication base stations. Despite efforts to lighten this load, the concurrent access of numerous devices can still result in high latency or, in graver scenarios, system failures. This paper proposes the integration of the p-probability delay strategy into our load balancing scheme. Furthermore, we introduce the concept of twice-assignment, which entails allocating distinct time slices to various terminal devices, provided their sending time are controllable. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we conducted a program simulation, revealing a conspicuously low collision rate. Finally, we present several methods to further mitigate collision rates.

articleTitle: Design of an Automated Security Protection System for Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In situations involving power system applications, a design plan for a new kind of automated security protection system has been put out. The self-repair vulnerability module, attack detection module, security policy configuration automation module, and front-end monitoring interface have all been designed for this article. This prototype system can secure device privacy and system stability while generating security policies automatically, responding to attacks quickly, and operating and maintaining expenses. This mostly entails the creation of self-repair and mining techniques for terminal vulnerabilities as well as detection techniques for malicious terminal-based assaults. In order to automatically create security protection device linkage methods, the automation module is configured to accept vulnerability and attack alert information. Each module opens its own database or offers interface forms for interactive operation and administration, while the front-end monitoring interface is created concurrently.

articleTitle: MSFNet: Multi-Stage Fusion Network for Myocardial Infarction Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) is a critical diagnostic tool in healthcare, and numerous deep learning models have been explored and applied to map ECG patterns to detect heart abnormalities. In this paper, we propose a novel network called Multi-stage Fusion Network (MSFNet), a multi-stage architecture network capable of accurately localizing abnormal segments within ECG sequences and performing myocardial infarction (MI) type diagnosis based on these segments. From the experiments on PTB-XL datasets, we observed that MSFNet achieves competitive performance compared to other methods.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of marine oil separator based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to develop a high-precision marine oil separator simulation system, a simulation model of the oil separator is built for the application of virtual simulation test and verification and training exercises, so as to realize the intuitive display of the separation and purification effect. By analyzing the working principle of typical marine oil separator, the mathematical models of oil separator production capacity, light liquid flow, oil, heavy liquid outlet pressure and fuel viscosity are established respectively, and each model is combined into a oil separator purification model.
