In the Matlab/Simulink simulation environment, the fuel data of different oil products are used as the input of the model for simulation test, and the experimental data such as purified oil (light liquid) oil and drainage (heavy liquid) outlet pressure at different times are obtained. The simulation results show that the established model can accurately reflect the separation operation effect of the ship oil separator, which has important reference significance for the design, debugging and control method of the ship fuel purification system.

articleTitle: RunFE: Architecture of Running Intensity Classification Based on 3D Facial Expression Encoder
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Classification of exercise intensity of running is critical and essential in fitness and rehabilitation training, which not only supports the design of training programs but also guards against secondary sports injury effectively. The accurate metrics of exercise intensity have become an important issue in sports science. However, existing methods have shortcomings in terms of objectivity, comfort, and real-time capabilities and do not consider emotional fatigue. Inspired by the association between physical fatigue and facial expression detail changes, an architecture (RunFE) is proposed to recognize running intensity objectively, non-intrusively, and non-disturbingly. RunFE consists of four components, with its core component being the 3D face reconstruction model (EMOCA) for encoding the runner’s facial expression, while the BiGRU is employed to extract the temporal features of facial expression. Classification experiments conducted based on the laboratory-acquired running facial datasets validated the efficiency of our method.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of an Intelligent Automated Automotive Steering Gear Test Bench
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the rapid progress of the times, cars have become a necessity that most families in society will purchase and use. Nowadays, new energy vehicles have entered people’s lives to a greater extent, and safety issues have always been the focus of social attention. Therefore, the most important aspect of safety issues for cars is the accuracy and safety of car steering gears, Therefore, the design and research of automotive steering gear test benches are extremely important. After understanding the current research status of automotive steering gear test benches at home and abroad, this article mainly focuses on improving the degree of automation and introduces an automated control system to achieve automatic control and data recording of the test process, improve work efficiency and accuracy of data analysis. And analyze and study the testing methods of automotive steering gear, the basic structure and principles of rack and pinion automotive steering gear, and propose a testing method for designing a comprehensive steering gear testing platform. Based on the principle of modular structural design for the test bench, the overall framework and layout plan of the test bench, as well as the overall design of the test bench, were conceived.

articleTitle: A walking assistance robot based on bionic traction characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the continuous development of social modernization, the research of various types of mobility aids is in full swing. However, most of the assistive devices on the market at present have the characteristics of single function, weak adaptability and low reliability, which makes it impossible for people to establish a trusting relationship with assistive devices and break through psychological barriers when traveling. The wearable walker uses the principles of ergonomics, kinematics, dynamics, bionics and other principles to design a walker for use in families and communities to help the elderly with lower limb movement and walking dysfunction caused by neurological diseases. Our research interests mainly include assisted exoskeletons, rehabilitation assistive devices, human softening belt design, fall protection system, rehabilitation evaluation system, and provide a complete rehabilitation diagnosis and treatment plan to help the elderly help rehabilitate walkers and gradually recover their walking ability. The implementation of the project involves computer vision, natural language processing, and multi-module collaborative analysis, which will help drive further research and development of walk-assist robots.

articleTitle: A Lightweight JSON Storage Method Based on Adjacency Linked Lists
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a popular data transformation and exchange standard for various different APIs (Application Program Interfaces) over the World Wide Web. With the increasing popularity of JSON format data in more and more applications, a natural problem is how to store and process JSON data efficiently. In this paper, we first survey the state of art methods to store and process JSON format data. There are mainly five ways to store and process JSON format data: the first way uses raw JSON data format in database systems, the second way uses native data type of databases to store JSON data, the third way uses a mapping or wrapper layer on the top of different database management systems to map or wrap JSON data into the underlying databases, the fourth way integrates JSON data in commercial database systems, and the fifth way uses specific data structures to store and process JSON data. Then, we give a formal description of JSON data based on tree model which can describe the data structures and semantics of the underlying JSON data. Finally, a method based on adjacency linked lists to store JSON data is proposed, in which the {key: value}pairs, and the relationships between keys of JSON data are preserved by the linked lists in the adjacency linked lists of JSON data, and the complexity of the method is analyzed in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on Compressed sensing and Transmission Methods of Video Resources Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To characterize the traffic load of virtual reality (VR) panoramic video under the spatio-temporal slicing transmission mode, firstly, based on a real-word VR video viewing dataset, the relationship between the traffic load and the spatio-temporal slicing strategy was evaluated via simulations. Secondly, on the basis of the simulation results, a statistical traffic model was established, describing the interaction between the traffic load and the number of spatial tiles as well as the duration of temporal chunks. Finally, based on the established model, a hierarchical spatial-temporal slicing strategy optimization method was proposed, where the outer layer found the optimal number of spatial tiles by exhaustive searching while the inner layer could directly compute the optimal duration of temporal chunks. Research and simulation results show that the traffic load approximately follows a normal distribution, where the mean and variance are functions of the spatio-temporal slicing strategy. By establishing the traffic model for each type of videos, the optimized slicing strategy based on the established model performs close to the optimal strategy obtained by searching by simulations.

articleTitle: Target Vessel Motion Model in an Intelligent Collision Avoidance Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: There are various methods for solving the constant bearing line (CBL) topic, and different algorithms have different applicability conditions and computational accuracy. In addressing such problems, the Lagrange series theory is employed to derive a precise solution formula for CBL based on the Mercator projection. Building upon this foundation, a target vessel motion model based on the CBL algorithm is proposed. This algorithm does not require iteration, exhibits high computational accuracy, and ingeniously applies the mathematical definition of angles to solve the azimuth calculation issue in CBL inverse solution without the need for quadrant determination. It is suitable for navigation across the equator. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of the proposed algorithm, particularly in the realm of computerization, and it holds practical value for estimating maritime vessel positions and calculating trajectories.

articleTitle: Phase Noise Measurement Method and Uncertainty Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Phase noise is one of the important indicators to measure the short-term frequency stability of signal source, and the size of phase noise directly reflects the accuracy and stability of signal source. Therefore, how to measure and analyze the phase noise of signals quickly and accurately is of great significance to the production, debugging and use of electronic equipment. This paper mainly introduces the definition, source and measurement method of phase noise, and briefly introduces the uncertainty. The measurement principles and steps of three phase noise measurement methods, including spectrum analyzer measurement method, frequency discrimination measurement method and phase discrimination measurement method, are emphatically described and analyzed, and the uncertainty of these three methods is analyzed. Finally, the three methods of phase noise measurement are compared, and the advantages and disadvantages of each method as well as the applicable occasions are given.

articleTitle: PID Control on Deformable Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To enhance the deficiencies of conventional PID control technology, which pertains to the incapacity to dynamically modify PID controller parameters when the system does not reach the targeted value or during variations in operating conditions, resulting in subpar control system response speed and excessive deviation, A combined intelligent control strategy based on Gaussian radial basis function neural network and fuzzy control has been proposed. Based on the error and the rate of change of the error, a incremental compensation-type two-dimensional Deformable Fuzzy Neural Network PID controller is constructed. The Jacobian matrix is obtained through the RBF neural network parameter identifier. The structure information of the Deformable Fuzzy Neural Network is determined through the variable structure algorithm. Simulation results in MATLAB/Simulink show that the control system improves the response speed and reduces overshoot during system startup and when the target value changes. And The system showcases minimal fluctuations in output when exposed to disturbances, swiftly reverting to the predetermined value, thereby optimizing the functionality of the control system.

articleTitle: Short-term load prediction of electric vehicle charging station based on Long-Short-Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Accurate charging load prediction of electric vehicle charging stations is an important method to improve the safe and economic operation of charging stations, and also an important basis to support the decision-making of new construction and expansion planning of charging infrastructure. In order to improve the accuracy of short-term charging load prediction of electric vehicle charging stations, a short-term charging load prediction method of charging stations based on Long-Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Neural Network is proposed. Firstly, data cleaning and outlier screening are used to preprocess the raw data to reduce the impact of raw data errors on the prediction results. Secondly, wavelet noise reduction is used to reduce the noise in the raw data, and finally, LSTM network is used to predict the charging load, and the simulation results show that the short-term charging load prediction model based on LSTM proposed in this paper has a high accuracy. At the same time, the LSTM can significantly shorten the training time and reduce the demand for computational resources.

articleTitle: Construction of Multi-scale Target Detection Model for Security Signage Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This study proposes a method for constructing a multi-scale target detection model specifically for power public safety signage. The article designs a multi-scale target detection network based on the YOLOv5 object detection model to meet the needs of multi-scale transformation and small target detection for safety signage. In addition, the article presents a quantitative perception training method of neural network graph optimization and network quantization, which is used to deploy the model at the edge and improve the inference speed. Experimental results show that this model exhibits high recognition accuracy and fast inference speed on edge devices, making it suitable for real-time safety signage recognition.

articleTitle: Torque optimization control strategy for pure electric motorcycles
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This article proposes a torque optimization control strategy based on fuzzy space. Establish a fuzzy controller that takes the difference in vehicle speed and the rate of change in accelerator opening as input variables, and the vehicle driving intention coefficient as output to determine the driver’s driving intention. Design the driving mode of the vehicle into three modes: power mode, general mode, and economic mode. The power mode adopts hard throttle curve control and adds a torque compensation module based on fuzzy control to improve the acceleration performance of the vehicle; In general mode, linear throttle curve control is adopted as a transitional mode that takes into account both economy and acceleration; Adopting soft throttle curve control mode in economic mode improves the driving economy of pure electric motorcycles. The simulation results show that compared with traditional torque control strategies, the torque optimization control strategy studied in this paper can accurately identify driving intentions, and the power and economy of motorcycles have been improved.

articleTitle: On the application of self -adaptation and mutation domain fuzzy algorithm in the optimization of the dynamic characteristics of micro -aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Adjust the gesture of small aircraft, adjust the use of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) servo control system aircraft size, different system rotation of the rudder ring installation position, etc., and the transition of the aircraft in the air encountered in the air. At the time, the traditional PI control method and fuzzy control method cannot solve the problem of slower system response and the problem of turning the system caused by it. This article proposes a fuzzy control algorithm based on model reference self -adaptation. First of all, the system’s rotation inertia parameters are recognized online through the MRAS algorithm, and then the identified results are fed back to the vague algorithm of the transformation domain to obtain a real -time PI parameter change volume to achieve precise control of the servo control system. Through the simulation verification, the results indicate that the model refer to the self -adaptation domain blur control algorithm has high accuracy of the online recognition of system rotation inertia. Compared with the traditional blur control method, the dynamic characteristics of the system have been improved.

articleTitle: Detection of Traffic Signs in Complex Weather Conditions Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Accurate and real-time detection of traffic signs in real-world scenarios is of paramount importance for traffic safety. To address the low precision issue when detecting small target traffic signs using YOLOv5 algorithm, this study proposes a detection algorithm specifically designed for small target traffic sign detection. Firstly, an SE module is introduced into the main network to focus on learning critical information within features. Secondly, a CoT module is incorporated into Neck network to facilitate comprehensive feature extraction of contextual information. Finally, a small target detection layer is introduced to enhance the model’s ability to detect small targets. Experimental results on TT100K dataset demonstrate that the proposed improved model achieves a 1.9% increase in accuracy, reaching 86.1%; a 2.3% increase in recall, reaching 79.5%; a 2.4% increase in mAP, reaching 85.5%; and an FPS of 33.4, meeting real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Decisions for Moving Target Defense Game Subject to Quality of Service Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Moving Target Defense (MTD) is an approach that aims to mitigate the inherent asymmetry between attackers and defenders by increasing the diversity of information systems. However, the implementation of MTD techniques can have a significant impact on the quality of service for users. To address this issue, we propose a Markov Stackelberg Game (MSG) MTD spatial-temporal decision model, which considers service quality as a constraint on decision-making in a space-time setting. Our model utilizes queuing theory to capture user behavior when requesting services, enabling the quantification and analysis of the impact of MTD technology implementation on user service quality. Additionally, our defender’s space strategy set covers MTD techniques at different levels of the system. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of the MSG model decisions using the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) scores of vulnerabilities in the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) and evaluate the impact of defender’s space strategy set and user service performance on MTD decision-making.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method of rolling bearing based on Xception-CNN model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: A fault diagnosis method based on Xception-CNN model was proposed to accurately diagnose the fault types of rolling bearings of belt conveyor transmission rollers under noise interference and variable load conditions. Firstly, based on Xception module, a CNN model body which integrates feature recognition and feature classification is designed, which can effectively reduce the dependence on expert knowledge. Secondly, an MP module is designed to replace the traditional maximum pooling layer, which can not only reduce the model training parameters, but also extract more feature information. Then, by introducing attention mechanism and residual learning mechanism into the model, the attention module can screen out more critical feature information, and the residual module can avoid gradient disappearance and network degradation to a certain extent. Finally, the proposed method and related deep learning methods are simulated and compared on the bearing data set of Case Western Reserve University. The experiments show that the average accuracy rate of the proposed model is 97.39% in the variable noise experiment and 94.58% in the variable load experiment, both of which are higher than other comparison methods, and have good universality and generalization ability.

articleTitle: Prediction of Distribution Network Load Release Stage Coefficients Using Crisscross Optimization Algorithm-Improved Back-Propagation Neural Network Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In traditional distribution network planning load forecasting, the load release stage coefficient, often referred to as the “stage coefficient,” for power customers is typically selected based on manual experience. This practice can lead to inaccurate load predictions, potentially resulting in unmet electricity demand or wasted investments. To address these issues, we propose a distribution network stage coefficient prediction model and method based on the Crisscross Optimization Algorithm-Improved Back-Propagation Neural Network (CSO-BPNN) algorithm. Firstly, we extract essential electricity consumption data from the metering automation and marketing systems of electric power enterprises to create a database of data samples. These samples are then cleaned, and a stage coefficient prediction model is constructed using the CSO-BPNN algorithm. Finally, by inputting the basic information of newly installed users, we obtain predicted stage coefficients. The proposed method is applied to the distribution network stage coefficient prediction for a power grid company, and its effectiveness and practicality are validated through a case study.

articleTitle: Design and application of pressure monitoring system of compressed air station based on LoRa wireless networking technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of the air compressor station, the pressure monitoring in the application process of various equipment in the room has become one of the key tasks to ensure the stable operation of the air compressor room and the smooth conduct of related experiments. The traditional pressure detection scheme of pointer pressure gauge has some problems, such as large subjective error, lack of real-time and inconvenient work. A real-time monitoring and early warning system for pressure in air compressor room based on Lora wireless networking technology is proposed. The pressure information of hyperbaric equipments in the station is monitored in real time through wireless sensor network, and remote data collection and management are realized, which effectively solves the problems existing in the traditional scheme and improves the reliability and scalability of the system. It is of great significance to the safety management, daily maintenance and the smooth development of related experiments of the compressed air station.

articleTitle: Dynamic Constrained Time-Domain Robust Optimization with Noises
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the field of engineering optimization design, there are many optimization problems with time-varying objective functions. Tracking motion optimization (TMO) and time domain Robust optimization (ROOT) are two widely used methods to solve this problem. The purpose of TMO is to find the optimal solution before the environment changes, while the purpose of ROOT is to find a solution that can adapt to changes over a long period of time. However, both TMO and ROOT approaches have some defects. First of all, the existing engineering optimization problems have constraints and will change with time. Second, in the optimizing environment, the noises in most environments will affect the candidates. Therefore, a dynamic constrained time-domain robust optimization algorithm (DCRO/SCNO) considering noises and switching costs is proposed in this paper. Switching cost and robustness are considered as multi-objective optimization, and the idea of double elite is introduced to divide the population into three groups to collaborate for the problem of non-robustness solutions in noisy environment. Benchmark experiments show that DCRO/SCNO can find non-dominant solutions in different noise environments, which confirms the validity of the dual elite idea.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Controllability of Complex Network Systems by Changing Coupling Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: How to control complex network systems is one of the research hotspots in network science. In recent years, much work has been carried out on the controllability of complex network systems. Inspired by the exact controllability theory of complex network systems, we study the optimization problem of the controllability of complex network systems based on adjusting the coupling coefficient in this paper. Our aim is to optimize the controllability of complex network systems by changing fewer coupling coefficients. A method based on maximum matching is proposed to determine the location of coupling coefficients that need to be changed. By comparing with random methods, we found that our optimization method can optimize the controllability of complex network systems to the optimal state faster and more stably. In addition, we found that the location of coupling coefficients is affected by the network topology. This work has a certain inspiring effect on further research on the controllability optimization of complex network systems.

articleTitle: Modeling Optimization of Prefabricated Parallel Production Manufacturing System Based on Hybrid Algorithm of Variable Neighborhood Taboo Search
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Taboo search (TS) algorithm is a kind of meta-heuristic algorithm with strong local search ability, has the advantages of strong local search ability and fast convergence speed, but at the same time there is a weak global development ability, easy to fall into the local optimum of the shortcomings. Because the variable neighborhoods (VNS) algorithm can use different actions to form the neighborhood structure for alternating search, and can achieve a better balance between the concentration and sparsity of the solution, the study proposes a hybrid algorithm of variable neighborhood taboo search (VNTS) to solve the pre-fabricated parallel production line order-delay penalty problem considering the resource constraints, and after generating a better machine allocation solution through the forbidden search, then the variable neighborhood search is used to derive the optimal order-to-production line allocation and the optimal order-to-production line allocation and the optimal order-to-production line allocation solution corresponding to this machine allocation solution within the algorithm. After generating a better machine allocation solution through taboo search, we then use variable neighborhood search to derive the optimal order-to-production line allocation and in-line scheduling scheme corresponding to this machine allocation solution within the algorithm, and compare the objective values to replace the lower quality solutions in the alternate iterations. Experiments show that the proposed hybrid algorithm VNTS has better robustness and solution quality.

articleTitle: Decentralized Multi-Authority Ciphertext-Policy Attribute-Based Encryption with Hidden Policy for Cloud Data Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Cloud storage services employ multi-authority attribute-based encryption (MA-ABE) with policy hiding extensively. However, in the existing MA-ABE schemes with policy hiding, all attributes are managed by a centralized authority (CA), which is also responsible for providing the user with the partial attribute keys needed for decryption. Thus, by calculating the required secret keys, CA may decrypt any ciphertext present in the cloud system. Moreover, it will increase the security risk of encrypted data in cloud. This paper proposes a decentralized multi-authority ciphertext-policy attribute-based encryption scheme that supports policy hiding. Participation in the proposed scheme does not require the centralized authority (CA), but rather numerous attribute authorities (AAS). Every AA manages several attribute sets and offers attribute keys for data users. In the encryption computation and key generation phase, we add an exponential operation to better protect the user’s sensitive data. Our scheme outperforms the current schemes in terms of functionality, as demonstrated by the performance analysis. Furthermore, the standard model has demonstrated the full security of our scheme.

articleTitle: Overfitting Identification in Machine Learning Models with the Person-Fit Indicator
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Overfitting is a phenomenon that can affect the generalization ability of machine learning models, but there is currently no clear criterion for identification. Overfitting models exhibit similar behavior to examinees with item preknowledge. Item preknowledge (IP) describes a situation in which a group of examinees have access to a subset of items from an administered test before the exam. One common method for identifying examinees with IP is based on the person-fit indicators, which are calculated using Item Response Theory (IRT). This study attempts to utilize the person-fit indicator to identify overfitting models. It is discovered that when the models adhere to the fundamental assumptions of IRT, the person-fit indicator exhibits the best recognition performance.

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Fault Analysis based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper builds an intelligent operation and maintenance platform based on machine learning algorithm through using the equipment level and system level fault monitoring data generated in the operation and maintenance process and combining with machine learning data analysis technology. It focuses on solving the difficult problems such as fault feature selection, fault diagnosis model classification, time series trend prediction, etc. The above research provides a decision-making reference for operating the communication links and making equipment maintenance scientifically, which has certain engineering application value and practical significance.

articleTitle: Dead-zone Compensation for Manipulator Based on Backstepping Adaptive Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: A adaptive sliding mode control scheme is proposed for a class of robot manipulator with unknown dead-zones and uncertain external disturbances, based on the combination of backstepping method and sliding mode control technology. The design take into account the phenomenon and the effect of dead-zone in the operation of robots control. The adaptive controller is used to realize the automatic compensation, to overcome the effect of dead-zone in the operation of robots control and to control the end-effector of the robot to reach the desired position. In order to force the system to work in the sliding modes as soon as possible and reduce the adverse effect caused by chattering on real-time control, the switching function, control law and adaptive law are presented by using backstepping method. With the Lyapunov principle and Barbalat’s lemma, it is proved that the controller is global stability and convergence of the tracking error. The feasibility of the control scheme is verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Sound Event Classification Based on Fusion of Multiple Pre-trained Models
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Although audio event classification is a task that involves recognizing event categories in audio signals, it is well-known that a single model may possess limited generalization ability, making it unable to accurately predict audio events. Therefore, this paper proposes a non-mean ensemble method. Specifically, this approach concatenates multiple classification models in the channel dimension and employs non-mean modules to generate learnable parameters, which enables confidence operations to be carried out on each model. By doing so, the approach does not rely on mean information from model outputs, but instead adapts weight adjustments based on learnable parameters, thereby enhancing its adaptability to different classification models and improving the flexibility of the prediction model. Furthermore, our test results on the official dataset of the 2023 DCASE Task4 demonstrate that the proposed method is effective. The best F1 score achieved by a single pre-trained model is 87.6%, with a corresponding mAP of 93.4%. After applying the non-mean ensemble method, the F1 score and mAP are respectively improved to 88.4% and 93.5%.

articleTitle: Construction and Implementation of Electric Power Deep Learning Computing Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to accurately and effectively identify the types and locations of abnormal information in the power industry, an electric power deep learning computing service platform is constructed to provide intelligent inspection services. The platform adopts hierarchical technology architecture, based on Docker technology, realizes the abstract pooling of many kinds of computing resources, and provides the management interface of heterogeneous resources such as GPU, NPU and so on according to the specific requirements of deep learning field, so as to realize the unified management and scheduling of heterogeneous resources, and provide an efficient, flexible and scalable distributed computing service supporting environment for deep learning computing tasks. The platform layer provides data center, development center, training center, model center, service center and other subsystems, and built-in a variety of learning frameworks and model algorithms to support external algorithm model integration. It really realizes the one-stop development ability of deep learning tasks. In the process of intelligent inspection of electric power, the online recognition and detection of a variety of abnormal information is realized, which provides a technical basis for on-line identification, supervision, prevention and control, comprehensive management of abnormal behavior.

articleTitle: Crowd counting in dense UAV images based on multiscale feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To achieve breakthrough performance in the task of dense crowd counting for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in complex environments, this paper introduces a multi-scale feature fusion crowd counting network model called MSFFCCNet. This model comprises two main components: a multi-scale feature extraction module and a feature fusion module. The former introduces diversity from multiple scales, where different scales focus on different information and generate scale-related features. The latter is responsible for fusing three features. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed MSFFCCNet outperforms existing crowd counting network models, exhibiting higher accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research progress and prospects on intelligent control methods for hypersonic flight vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Hypersonic flight vehicle is a complex system coupled with fast time-varying, strong coupling, high nonlinearity and large uncertainty. These factors bring huge challenges to the control effect of the vehicle in actual practice. Compared with the traditional control strategy, the intelligent control methods have the characteristics of self-adaptation and online learning by using key technologies such as multi-data fusion and multi-objective optimization, which can better deal with the control difficulties during the mission execution, effectively improving the flight stability and control accuracy of hypersonic flight vehicles in complex flight environments. In this paper, to highlight the general trend of hypersonic flight vehicle control, the existing control methods are summarized in conjunction with related research on hypersonic flight vehicles around the world. Besides, focusing on the trend of intelligence, the core ideas and progresses of several intelligent control methods are highlighted, and the key technologies involved in intelligent control strategies, such as multi-source information fusion, multi-agent collaborative control, bus communication networks and intelligent optimization algorithms, are also summarized. Finally, prospects on the future intelligent control of hypersonic flight vehicles are made.

articleTitle: Mutation Scheduling optimization Strategy based on Fuzzy Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, various software has become an integral part of people’s daily life. However, software security issues have attracted widespread attention from security researchers worldwide and led to many major incidents. Fuzzy testing is one of the most effective methods in software vulnerability mining, and has become a hot research topic in security field recently. However, traditional fuzzy testing methods usually use fixed probability to select variation operators and stack sizes, without taking into account the dynamic changes in the efficiency of different variation operators and stack sizes during fuzzy testing, which seriously affects its overall efficiency. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a fuzzy test variation scheduling optimization strategy, which uses an improved artificial bee colony algorithm to dynamically adjust the selection probabilities of variation operators and stack sizes, and proposes an adaptation value calculation method and a bee colony search method for variation scheduling target scenarios. After experimental verification, the optimization strategy proposed in this paper can effectively improve the efficiency of fuzzy testing.

articleTitle: A Situation Deduction Method for Rail Transit Network Based on Dynamic Bayesian Network with Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the past work, we proposed a transport capacity risk prediction method based on linear Gaussian Bayesian network. Aiming at the problem that the global capacity risk index is single and the existing methods are difficult to deal with dynamic and nonlinear data, this paper proposes a method of transportation safety situation deduction for rail transit network based on dynamic Bayesian network and Gaussian mixture model, combined with the situation awareness theory. The hierarchical transport capacity risk is used as the core to construct the network safety situation index system. According to the network topology and the interaction between the transport capacity risk and the single point risk, the dynamic Bayesian network is constructed. The EM algorithm is used to estimate the parameters of the Gaussian mixture model to realize the Bayesian network parameter learning. This method is verified by the example of Chongqing rail transit network, and the prediction performance outperforms other comparison methods.

articleTitle: Flow Perturbations Control of Compressor under Inlet Flow Distortion using Unsteady Jet Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper investigates the control of flow perturbations in a compressor under inlet flow distortion utilizing unsteady jet injection. The study focuses on the impact of inlet flow distortion on compressor stability and the variations in stability under unsteady jet injection control. A multidimensional compressor system model and a jet injection device model are established, and an algorithm for unsteady jet injection control is designed, considering the perturbations model of inlet flow distortion. Numerical simulations are conducted to analyze the dynamic response of the compressor system under inlet flow distortion perturbations of various amplitudes and frequencies. The results demonstrate that unsteady jet injection effectively suppresses flow perturbations caused by inlet flow distortion, enabling stability control of the compressor’s inlet flow perturbations. And the sensitivity of the unsteady jet injection control is dependent on the frequency rather than the amplitude of the flow perturbations. Additionally, the effectiveness of unsteady jet injection in suppressing inlet flow distortion decreases with an increase in flow perturbations frequency.

articleTitle: Study on Adaptive Cruise Control Systems of Passenger Vehicles and Solutions Based on V2X Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety. However, ACC systems suffer from limitations such as inadequate single-vehicle perception. Current research predominantly focuses on target recognition algorithms, overlooking the technological pathways for enhancing ACC system performance through vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-infrastructure cooperative technologies. This paper provides a comprehensive review of ACC technology’s development and current state, encompassing ACC products from automotive manufacturers, relevant standards, regulations, and associated research theories while summarizing the existing issues in contemporary ACC technology. Furthermore, this paper explores ACC technology solutions based on these cooperative and networked approaches by analyzing the current status and advantages of vehicle-to-vehicle cooperation and vehicle-to-infrastructure communication technology (V2X). The study reveals that by integrating vehicle-to-vehicle cooperation and vehicle-to-infrastructure communication technologies, it is possible to cost-effectively improve the reliability and safety of ACC systems in scenarios such as cornering, driving on wet or slippery surfaces, and encountering stationary obstacles. This research provides theoretical support for the development of ACC systems, further enhancing road traffic safety and operational efficiency.

articleTitle: IoTAEG: Automatic Exploit Generation of IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Automatic exploit generation (AEG) refers to the process of automatically finding the path in the program that can trigger vulnerabilities and generate exploits. Generally speaking, the process of finding vulnerabilities needs to apply fuzzing and symbolic execution techniques. Existing AEG generally targets executables for regular Linux and Windows platforms, but no AEG for vulnerable Internet of Things (IoT) devices. In response to this situation, we propose the exploit generation system IoTAEG, which automatically detects stack overflow vulnerabilities in the firmware of IoT devices, and automatically generates and exploits the generation system based on the stack overflow vulnerabilities. IoTAEG uses the mature fuzzing software AFL++ to detect vulnerabilities in IoT devices, uses the crashed input found by AFL++ to construct a symbolic state through symbolic execution, dynamically analyzes the constructed symbolic state, and detects whether there are exploitable vulnerabilities. If the above vulnerabilities exist, different exploit generation strategies will be adopted for different protection mechanisms, and some protection mechanisms such as Address space layout randomization (ASLR) and Non-eXecute (NX) will be bypassed. For some difficult-to-exploit cases, IoTAEG uses advanced stack overflow exploitation methods to generate exploits. Experiments show that IoTAEG can complete 20 MIPS/ARM binary files and 8 IoT devices’ firmware vulnerability detection and exploit generation. IoTAEG is the first publicly available vulnerability mining and exploit generation system for IoT devices.

articleTitle: Task Scheduling Based on Heterogeneous Priority and Critical Task Duplication
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Efficient task scheduling algorithms can reduce the overall task scheduling length and improve the efficiency of task execution in heterogeneous environments. However, most task scheduling algorithms ignore the heterogeneity of tasks when calculating the task scheduling order, so they are not suitable for heterogeneous environments. And a large number of free slots are generated to increase the scheduling length in the processor selection phase. So we present a task scheduling algorithm based on heterogeneous priority and critical task duplication by combining static table scheduling algorithm and task duplication algorithm with the main goal of minimizing task scheduling length. In priority calculation phase, we integrate the computation cost variance and node out degree to reveal the heterogeneity of task cost and data transmission. In the processor selection phase, if duplicating the critical parent task of current task can reduce its actual start time, we duplicate the critical parent task to the processor on which current task is scheduled for the purpose of reducing its overall scheduling length ultimately. We evaluate our method over the randomly generated graphs and some simulation comparison charts. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the other three comparison algorithms.

articleTitle: Attention ResNet-GRU model for Typhoon Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Multimodal data analysis refers to the integration of different types of data (such as images and numerical features) to leverage the complementarity and interactive information between various data sources, aiming to enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of analytical tasks. The advantage of multi- modal methods lies in their ability to comprehensively utilize diverse data sources, thereby providing more comprehensive and accurate analysis results. Consequently, they have significant advantages in various prediction tasks. In this study, we investi- gate multimodal data analysis methods using a typhoon dataset obtained from the Chinese Academy of Sciences’ Ocean Science Data Center. Through preprocessing, intensity mapping, and data augmentation techniques, we construct a dataset containing features such as longitude, typhoon category, wind speed, and typhoon intensity. To improve prediction accuracy, we utilize the data from the past five days to predict the current typhoon longitude and combine every five samples into a complete ty- phoon record. Additionally, we transform numerical features into images and normalize them to enhance data representation. In terms of model design, we employ a multimodal neural network, where ResNet and a GRU network with multi-head attention mechanism handle image and data features, respectively. The typhoon longitude prediction is achieved through feature fusion and fully connected layers. Experimental results demonstrate that the multimodal approach outperforms single-modal methods in regression tasks. This research holds significance for typhoon path prediction and disaster prevention.

articleTitle: Improved Load Balancing Algorithm for a Novel Distributed Computing Framework Based on MultiObjective Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Ray is a novel distributed computing framework designed for artificial intelligence computations and has been widely applied in various fields. However, its default load balancing algorithm, which is based on the equal distribution approach, often leads to load imbalance issues. In this paper, we propose a load balancing algorithm based on multi-objective optimization to address the load imbalance problem in Ray. The algorithm utilizes an ideal similarity-based sorting solution to improve the shortcomings of Ray’s default load balancing algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively improves the load balancing performance.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for Weather Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The study of identifying and categorizing weather images is closely connected to our daily routines and the economy. It affects decisions such as whether to bring an umbrella for the day or the agricultural earnings of an entire country for the year. However, the complexities within the domain of weather classification are manifold, owing to the subtle nature of weatherrelated image features and the multitude of factors contributing to image variability. In this context, we explore the efficacy of three distinct deep learning models: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Visual Geometry Group (VGG) networks, and Vision Transformer (ViT) models, to address the challenges posed by ambiguous attributes of weather images. The above models exhibit notable differences in their architectural nuances. CNNs excel at capturing local features through convolutional layers. VGG networks are adept at learning intricate feature hierarchies via their deep architecture. ViT, leveraging self-attention mechanisms, excels in capturing global context from images. These models collectively tackle the issue of indistinct weather features by extracting and learning relevant patterns at different scales and levels of abstraction. Our experimentation employs a diverse weather dataset encompassing ten categories, including sunny, cloudy, rainy, snowy, and others, each comprising 500 images. The results are promising, with all three models achieving classification accuracies exceeding 90%. This study underscores the potential of CNNs, VGG networks, and ViT models in effectively categorizing weather images despite the inherent challenges, contributing to improved weather understanding and forecasting, and ultimately benefiting various sectors of society.

articleTitle: Research on OTDOA Positioning Method for 5G in Multipath Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Observed time difference of arrival (OTDOA) positioning method of 5G selects the time of arrival (TOA) due to the serving base station signal as the reference, and subtracts the TOAs of other observation base stations from the reference to obtain the reference signal time difference (RSTD), each RSTD value corresponds to a hyperbola equation, on which the user equipment (UE) is assumed to be located. The performance of TOA measurement directly affects the OTDOA positioning accuracy. In wireless channel, the optimal accuracy of TOA is obtained under line of sight (LOS) condition, where the signal propagates directly from the source to the receiver. However, for 5G UE in urban areas, the multipath of non-Los caused by obstacles can cause deep signal fading, greatly reducing measurement accuracy. TOA of the first path in multipath environment needs to be accurately measured as it is closest to the actual TOA. To address this issue, the classic correlation algorithm for the first path detection has been proposed as an effective method. This paper is based on correlation algorithm and combines it with convolutional neural networks (CNN) to further improve the TOA measurement accuracy under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Simulation results show that this proposed method effectively improve the OTDOA positioning accuracy of 5G UE in multipath channel.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Comparing Results for Multiple Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the contemporary landscape of atmospheric sciences, the ability to recognize specific weather phenomena accurately and efficiently has become paramount, largely due to the exponential growth in sensor-generated data. This paper undertakes an in-depth analysis of advanced algorithms, namely YOLOV8, ResNet50, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), for the purpose of weather pattern identification and classification. Building on the foundation of deep learning, the YOLOV8's real-time object detection capabilities are leveraged to discern intricate weather patterns in diverse datasets, from meteorological stations to satellite imagery. On the other hand, Resnet 50 which is another CNN based model was also tested along with CNN for comparison. An exhaustive evaluation of these algorithms covers various metrics, including accuracy, precision, computational efficiency, and real-world applicability. Special emphasis is placed on the crucial stages of data preprocessing, feature extraction, and model tuning, highlighting their impact on the algorithms' overall performance. Our findings suggest that, when appropriately optimized, both YOLOV8 and CNN exhibit exceptional capabilities in discerning and classifying intricate weather patterns, whereas ResNet50 exhibits comparatively less performance.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on enhanced knowledge distillation and lightweight convolution network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high time ductility, low calculation accuracy and unfriendly hardware deployment in practical engineering in rolling bearing fault diagnosis methods under strong noise background, a new kind of Improved Knowledge Distillation was proposed. (IKD) lightweight convolutional Neural Network fault diagnosis method. In order to reduce the increase of computing time caused by channel addition in the process of convolution, standard pointwise convolution and channel shuffle are used to design the basic unit of the network. On this basis, the IKD algorithm is used to train the student network (IKDStu) based on the pre-trained teacher network (TeacherNet). Simulation analysis shows that under the background of the given data with strong noise, the student network trained by the proposed method can ensure the accuracy of diagnosis, reduce the size of the model and the number of parameters, and improve the efficiency of diagnosis.

articleTitle: Unbalance fault diagnosis of Marine gas turbine based on RDE-SVM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: As ship automation gradually advances, the automatic maintenance of ship propulsion systems becomes increasingly important, and currently, common maintenance often takes place after a breakdown. This paper, through research on data-driven models for marine gas turbines, proposes a state maintenance and diagnostic method based on a combination of the Ranking-Based Differential Evolution (RDE) algorithm and support vector machine (SVM) algorithm. Initially, an anomaly detection model describing normal sample distribution is trained by using the SVM optimized by RDE algorithm. Then, a diagnostic model is separately trained for each fault to describe the decision boundary to classify gas-path faults. Comparison of the proposed method with traditional methods show that the proposed method can effectively address the data imbalance and overfitting issues, and it can detect abnormal conditions in marine gas turbine with only a few samples.

articleTitle: Couple-Group Consensus for Leader-Following Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems under Network Attacks and Decay
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In this article, the problem of couple-group consensus for the leader-following nonlinear multi-agent systems affected by network attacks and decay is investigated by adaptive state observer methods. Due to the different tasks of multiple subsystems of a multi-agent system, the long communication distance between different subsystems, and the frequent communication during the collaborative process of agents, it is necessary to consider the effects of external network attacks and decay. Firstly, a new control protocol is proposed by Lyapunov function and matrix theory. Based on algebraic graph theory, some sufficient conditions for the network topology are given to ensure that the nonlinear system reaches a group bounded consensus. Then, the nonlinear terms of the agents are approximated by an adaptive neural network algorithm and the network decay rate is obtained by the designed adaptive law. A state observer is designed based on the data obtained by the adaptive algorithm to recover the disturbed signals, thus bringing the system back to group consensus. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the correctness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Speed optimization for fuel saving of a marine diesel engine generator in DC power station base on GWPSO algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The ship’s electricity load changes dynamically with the operating conditions. Compared with the fixed-speed diesel generator set, the variable speed diesel generator set can change the diesel engine speed according to the load condition, so that the diesel engine can operate in a higher efficiency range and achieve the purpose of fuel saving. Taking the lowest fuel consumption rate as the optimization objective, combined with the diesel engine average model of the thermal efficiency neural network model as the basis of fuel consumption rate calculation, the upper and lower limit of diesel speed and power limit line as the limit conditions of speed range, the acquisition of fuel saving speed under different load conditions as an optimization problem. The simulation results show that the diesel engine model has high precision with maximum error 1.62% and can be used for optimization calculation. The characteristics of particle swarm optimization algorithm and Grey Wolf algorithm are analyzed, and a hybrid algorithm (GWPSO) is proposed by combining the advantages of both, and the advantages of the combined algorithm are verified by standard function. The optimization results show that the lower the power load, the more obvious the fuel saving effect; The fuel saving rate can reach more than 30% when the load is 10%, and the comprehensive fuel saving rate can reach 11.9%. The optimized speed can effectively reduce the fuel consumption rate of the variable speed generator set. Grey Wolfparticle swarm optimization algorithm can improve the accuracy of optimization algorithm. The GWPSO algorithm has more balanced global and local optimization characteristics and is more suitable for the optimization of the lowest fuel consumption rate.

articleTitle: Analysis and Applications of 2D Discrete Fourier Transform in Image Denoising and Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The paper explores what is 2 Dimensional Fourier Transform and how it can be used for image processing, specifically denoising and edge enhancing. Starting from the Fourier theorem and Fourier series, the paper traverses through a detailed procedure for the derivation from the 1 dimensional continuous to 1 dimensional discrete to 2 dimensional discrete to 2 dimensional inverse discrete Fourier Transform. After the image is transformed to frequency domain with Fourier transform, highpass and lowpass filters can be applied to edit the information for the purpose of image processing. Such image processing techniques is then implemented on to two examples, a matrix example and an image example, and one accounts for the mathematics approach and another for analyzing the effect of the highpass and lowpass filters, respectively.

articleTitle: A text detection algorithm for natural scenes based on improved GAU and CBAM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper studies the problems related to text detection in natural scenes, focusing on convolutional neural networks, full convolutional networks, Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN), semantic segmentation, Global Attention Upsample Module (GAU) and Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). Targeting at the low accuracy of current text detection algorithms, a text detection algorithm based on improved GAU and CBAM in natural scene is proposed. The CBAM is first embedded in the GAU module of FPN, and then the improved network is used for text detection base on FPN semantic segmentation. Experimental results show that the network is feasible and stable and the algorithm in this paper has higher accuracy and recall rate compared with similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Dangerous Art Paintings: Artistic Adversarial Attacks on Salient Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Recently, deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are found to be vulnerable to inputs with some imperceptible perturbations. However, existing adversarial attacks add noise that conforms to certain distribution which can be detected and defended easily. In this paper, we propose a novel attack approach for Salient Object Detection (SOD) network: artistic adversarial attacks. Inspired by the style transfer task, we work on adding learnable adversarial noise by changing texture. Specifically, we propose a hybrid loss function to add attack texture in the original image. Meanwhile, we present a color fusion method to make the adversarial texture more imperceptible and authentic. We come up with a white-box training and black-box testing strategy to stimulate real attack. Experiments demonstrate that our style-transferred images have fooled 10 state-of-the-art detection networks with enough authenticity and naturalness. The source code is available at: https://github.com/NorthForest233/Art.
